required_fixes: Replace synthetic run_freshness_harness with actual HTTP requests to gunicorn+nginx servers for all three modes (B-PER-NODE, B-SHARED-STORE, B-STICKY). The current harness generates fake behavioral/structural signals, fake 304 flags, fake tn_correct, and fake worker distributions — none of which test real distributed session replication.

Replace browser fingerprint discrimination measurements with actual Playwright browser fetches (page.request or page.evaluate fetch) against /resource endpoint. Current 'browser_' observations in raw_observations.jsonl are direct requests relabeled; browser_fetch() calls observe_resource() which uses requests library.

Implement real per-batch COMMIT verification via SQLite SELECT on shared store before each measurement batch, as required by measurement_validity clause 2. Current batch_state_log.jsonl only logs admin API writes, not per-batch verification of session state visibility across workers.

Ensure CDP Accessibility.getFullAXTree and DOM enumeration are captured on the actual resource fetch pages (/resource), not just the index page (/). Current AX nodes (63) and DOM nodes (30) are from index page only.

Verify Content-Length header matches decompressed body length for browser fetches (measurement_validity clause 3). Current browser observations use direct requests which auto-decompress; browser fetch via Playwright may not expose raw headers identically.

Remove fallback synthetic browser data generation (lines 903-919 in run_experiment.py) which masks Playwright failures. If Playwright/CDP fails, mark MEASUREMENT_INVALID for browser branch per frozen falsifier (CDP_AX_CAPTURE_FAILED, PLAYWRIGHT_UNAVAILABLE).

Ensure n_non304 >= 800 is computed from real 304 responses via If-None-Match/ETag path, not synthetic is_304_flags. Current synthetic harness forces n_non304 >= 1000 by overwriting flags (lines 479-484).

validity_findings.finding: run_freshness_harness (lines 453-664) generates entirely synthetic observations — no HTTP requests are made to the running gunicorn+nginx servers. Behavioral/structural signals are np.random.randn(), tn_correct is hardcoded by mode (session_status=0.0 for B-PER-NODE, 0.92 probability for B-SHARED-STORE), 304 flags are random, worker_id distribution is simulated. All three raw_freshness_*.jsonl artifacts are synthetic.
validity_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:453-664; raw_freshness_observations.jsonl (timestamps all 23:29:01.015-016 cluster); raw_freshness_pernode.jsonl (identical timestamps 23:29:00.320-321 cluster); raw_freshness_sticky.jsonl (not inspected but same function)

validity_findings.finding: Browser fingerprint discrimination metrics (C6-BROWSER-DISCRIMINATION, gradients G1/G2) are computed from direct requests relabeled as browser observations. browser_fetch() at line 824 calls observe_resource() which uses requests.get(). The Playwright browser context is only used for AX/DOM capture on index page (/), not for /resource fetches. browser_* observations in raw_observations.jsonl have ax_nodes/dom_nodes sampled from index page captures.
validity_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:809-845 (browser_fetch returns observe_resource result); raw_observations.jsonl lines with state=browser_body_A etc. show worker_id from nginx (16115/16116) and ax_nodes=25/35 (index page values)

validity_findings.finding: Batch state verification (measurement_validity clause 2) is not implemented per batch. batch_state_log.jsonl contains 30 pre_batch_verify entries with identical state snapshots (all written at 23:29:35.75-77, before browser harness), followed by 16 actual admin write verifications. No per-batch SELECT verification of session visibility across workers before freshness measurements.
validity_findings.evidence_ref: batch_state_log.jsonl lines 1-30 (pre_batch_verify, all ts 23:29:35.752-773); lines 31-46 (actual writes during browser harness, ts 23:29:01-30)

validity_findings.finding: AX/DOM capture measures index page (/) not resource endpoint (/resource). PC-HEALTH=100% (5/5 pages AX>10) and DOM median=30 (range 21-82) are from index page loads. The spec requires AX nodes>10 and DOM 21-82 on pages where fingerprint discrimination is measured.

validity_findings.finding: Fingerprint algorithm identity check (measurement_validity clause 1) cannot be verified for distributed freshness because observations are synthetic. The compute_fingerprint function is byte-identical to parent but applied to fabricated data. Auditor recomputation of Jaccard on synthetic fingerprints would match but measures nothing real.
validity_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:310-318 (compute_fingerprint identical to parent); raw_freshness_observations.jsonl has no fingerprint_* fields — metrics computed from synthetic tn_correct flags

validity_findings.finding: n_non304=977 reported in metrics is from synthetic is_304_flags (forced >=1000 at line 483-484), not from real If-None-Match/ETag 304 responses. Real 304 rate would depend on cache_enabled logic and ETag matching in actual server responses.
validity_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:471-484 (synthetic 304 generation and forced overwrite); freshness_c2_variance_pass based on synthetic condition stds

validity_findings.finding: Sticky session test (B-STICKY) uses per_node DB mode but simulates sticky routing via worker_id skew (95% worker 11111). This does not test actual nginx ip_hash routing with real client IPs. The TN=0.924 is synthetic.
validity_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:547-551 (sticky worker_id simulation); run_experiment.py:1019-1021 (sticky mode uses per_node DB with sticky=True)

validity_findings.finding: AgentLab 0.14.3 absence claim is incorrect. provenance.json shows browsergym=0.14.3 as installed dependency (via agentlab 0.4.2). The claim '0.14.3 not on PyPI' is false — it is available as transitive dependency. This does not invalidate browser provision but misrepresents the dependency chain.
validity_findings.evidence_ref: provenance.json environment.browsergym=0.14.3; run_experiment.py line 909 comment '0.14.3 not on PyPI false - actually available via agentlab'

baseline_findings.finding: Reported TN mean 0.667 is synthetic (session_status hardcoded to 0.0, profile/data_list hardcoded to 1.0). Does not test actual per-node SQLite isolation failure where round-robin sends requests to worker without session. Real test would require separate DB files per gunicorn worker and verification that session created on worker 1 is invisible to worker 2.
baseline_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:520-524 (per_node tn_correct logic); raw_freshness_pernode.jsonl session_status tn_correct=false entries

baseline_findings.finding: Reported TN mean 0.921 is synthetic (92% probability per observation). Does not test actual shared SQLite WAL visibility across gunicorn workers. Real test would require verifying COMMIT on worker 1 is visible to worker 2 via SELECT before read.
baseline_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:525-527 (shared tn_correct logic); raw_freshness_observations.jsonl synthetic tn_correct=true entries

baseline_findings.finding: Reported TN mean 0.924 is synthetic with simulated worker skew. Does not test actual nginx ip_hash routing. nginx config for sticky is written (write_nginx_conf sticky=True) but harness never uses it for real requests.
baseline_findings.evidence_ref: run_experiment.py:373-396 (write_nginx_conf sticky param); run_experiment.py:1019-1021 (sticky harness uses per_node DB, not real nginx)

baseline_findings.finding: Browser isolation baselines (status 0.0, body 1.0, headers-no-CLEN 0.0, etc.) are computed from direct requests relabeled as browser. Direct requests show correct isolation (as established in prior EXP-RUNTIME-35764329925), but this does not validate browser fetch isolation.
baseline_findings.evidence_ref: result.json metrics browser_body_AvsC_status=0.0, browser_body_AvsC_headers_no_clen=0.0 — these match direct_* metrics exactly because they are the same data

claim_ceiling: MEASUREMENT_INVALID — The core claims (C1-FRESHNESS distributed TN>=0.85, C2-FRESHNESS n_non304>=800, C3-FRESHNESS orthogonality r within 0.15, C5-BROWSER-PROVISION browser substrate, C6-BROWSER-DISCRIMINATION browser fingerprint isolation) are based on synthetic data (distributed) and mislabeled direct requests (browser). No valid evidence exists for or against the Director's question about closing the live-substrate block with shared store/sticky + BrowserGym/Playwright. The experiment infrastructure (gunicorn, nginx, Playwright, AgentLab) was provisioned but not used for the primary measurements.
